facts.fact: The FMI peer review says Rwanda accesses EUMETSAT satellite products through a ground-based satellite receiver, and that Meteo Rwanda's forecasting draws on EUMETSAT satellite imagery alongside a C-band radar.
The FMI peer review says Meteo Rwanda has an ISO9001:2015 certified QMS since 2018, last audited in 2022 and valid until 2025, including all branches of service.
facts.system: Meteo Rwanda ISO 9001:2015 quality management system
